projections.source_time_basis: HYCOM instantaneous March/June/September/December15,2022 00Z;quarterly probes,not seasonal means or annual envelopes.
projections.projection_gate: Interior maximum of complete finite declared current-specific signed interval without surface qualification;resolved declared primary lower contour;axis identity remains unvalidated.
projections.branch_scope: Partial northern PNG reach142-146E downstream of Vitiaz. Exclude Vitiaz Strait,upstream Solomon Sea branches,surface NGCC identity,New Britain and equatorial retroflection/EUC. Fixed290degree northwest component is an editorial approximation based on local142E alongshore orientation,not an along-route rotated axis. A connected same-sign surface layer can merge NGCC and NGCUC;this diagnostic does not classify water masses or establish branch separation.
projections.interpolation_assumption: Keep every original fixed-longitude section in declared downstream order. Use selected native model positions;where no column qualifies,use actualnativewrappedlongitude and the declaredlatitude-gate midpoint only as an explicit unresolved reference geometry placeholder with no sampled position or depth. ShortestWGS84legs connect adjacentoriginal references,including across180/-180. Assume linear lowerdepth and paired modelspan only between neighboring original supported nodes;never skip,extrapolate or fill from an alternate cutoff. Distances are reference geometry,not measured current lengths.
